cuts.reason: Cuts from the live skit's final beat (wife's deadpan punchline 'Holding hands is nothing.') into a static title-card overlay laid over the same frozen two-shot, marking the joke's end and branding the episode ('LOW BATTERY PEOPLE, created by NIN.').
Hard cut from the title-card overlay to a plain black outro card with the 'NEW EPISODE DAILY' CTA tag, giving the channel branding/subscribe prompt its own clean beat right after the laugh.

pacing_notes: The entire skit plays out in a single unbroken ~11.6s locked two-shot of the couple, with no internal cuts — all comedic timing comes from the dialogue's rhythm and pauses (setup, deflection, the 'Like what?' beat, then the punchline) rather than editing. Only after the punchline lands does the edit speed up sharply: a brief ~0.4s title-card overlay immediately followed by a ~0.9s black outro card, turning the pacing from one long sustained shot into two quick branding beats for the button/CTA.
